title: Package Manifest Load
description: Load the approved project package manifest and preserve its stable entry order before export.
intent: Acquire the canonical project package manifest (projects/gwc/package.yaml) via a mutually-exclusive source XOR source_path evaluator argument, parse YAML via yaml.safe_load as a JSON-compatible object, validate it against the closed schemas/project-package.schema.json, and build deterministic entries preserving declared instruction order for downstream entry-schema-validation. Resolve a separate exact 40-hex Git source SHA as controller-decided execution input. No filesystem write, copy, target mutation, or network access beyond read-only source resolution.
outcome: Typed ManifestLoadResult with schema_id, schema_version, outcome (LOADED|BLOCKED), manifest_digest (sha256: semantic, no timestamps), binding (full SourceBinding: task_id, repository, package_path, source_ref, source_sha, package_version), source_sha (exact Git commit SHA, 40-hex), entries (preserving declared instruction order), errors (ordered by reason taxonomy), authority_granted (always false). Compatibility aliases: LoadResult = ManifestLoadResult, OUTCOME_LOADED, OUTCOME_BLOCKED.
constraints: The same manifest bytes and source SHA must always produce the same deterministic entries, manifest_digest, and replay identity.
source and source_path are mutually-exclusive function arguments; neither is ever written into the canonical package payload.
source_sha is an exact Git commit SHA (40 hex), never a content hash or SHA256(payload).
observed_source_sha is execution-only keyword-only input; it must never appear in the result, to_dict, or schema.
Exactly one source mode: source XOR source_path; both present => BLOCKED ambiguous-source; neither => BLOCKED missing-source. No fallback guessing.
SourceBinding must include task_id, repository, package_path, source_ref, source_sha, package_version; missing/incomplete => BLOCKED using closed task taxonomy.
observed_source_sha and binding.source_sha are both valid 40-hex for success; missing/invalid observed => BLOCKED missing/incomplete input; observed != binding.source_sha => MANIFEST_STALE_SOURCE.
payload["package_version"] must equal binding.package_version; mismatch => MANIFEST_STALE_SOURCE.
manifest_digest is a deterministic sha256: semantic digest of loaded canonical manifest content, excluding timestamps.
Decision/replay identity must include normalized payload + loaded manifest + FULL binding identity + observed Git SHA so semantic binding changes cannot disappear.
No schema weakening to satisfy fixtures.
The typed result — not an exit code and not "the parser did not crash" — is the only success signal.
exclusions: Filesystem existence or path-root safety checks (belong to source-path-safety-check and target-path-safety-check).
Entry-level schema field validation (belong to package_export.entry-schema-validation).
Granting repository, PR, merge, deploy, or release authority.
Mutating repository state or changing gate authority.
Network access or production data operations.
Credential, secret, migration, or destructive operations.
Promoting source_status; canonical_explicit=4 / proposed_registry_slot=77 invariant is preserved, not authored here.
entry_guards: G2 authority validated independently for this node

reason_codes.MANIFEST_LOADED: The manifest loaded successfully and produced deterministic entries bound by a valid SourceBinding.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_MISSING: The source/source_path is absent or the SourceBinding is missing/incomplete.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_PARSE_ERROR: The manifest YAML/JSON could not be parsed via yaml.safe_load (malformed, non-object root).
reason_codes.MANIFEST_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: The manifest declares an unrecognized or unsupported schema_version.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: The manifest schema_version is recognized in taxonomy but not supported by this loader.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_STALE_SOURCE: observed_source_sha is missing/invalid, or observed_source_sha != binding.source_sha, or payload package_version != binding.package_version.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_DUPLICATE_ENTRY_ID: Two or more manifest entries share the same id after normalization.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE: Both source and source_path are present (source XOR source_path), or source resolution is otherwise ambiguous.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_REPLAY_CONFLICT: Same key + valid semantic identity change (payload, task, repo, path, ref, Git SHA, or version) detected on replay.
reason_codes.MANIFEST_MISSING_INSTRUCTIONS: The manifest instructions list is absent or empty after precheck.
